searchText: But ... I'm still reviewing them, and it's midnight, and I thought I'd pick it up again tomorrow. I'd give people a little while to have fun with them. Also I don't know that April Fools Day landing on AllCoreDevs day will ever happen again, so these might be of some historic value.
